text.3:124: When thou didst say unto the believers: Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should support you with three thousand angels sent down (to your help)?
text.3:125: Nay, but if ye persevere, and keep from evil, and (the enemy) attack you suddenly, your Lord will help you with five thousand angels sweeping on.
text.17:6: Then we gave you once again your turn against them, and We aided you with wealth and children and made you more in soldiery.
text.17:20: Each do We supply, both these and those, from the bounty of thy Lord. And the bounty of thy Lord can never be walled up.
text.23:55: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them
text.26:132: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,
text.26:133: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.
text.27:36: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon, (the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth? But that which Allah hath given me is better than that which He hath given you. Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift.
text.52:22: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
text.71:12: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
